subject: Communication Systems
questionText:
A modulating signal is amplified by a 80% efficiency
amplifier before being combined with a 20 kW carrier
to generate an AM signal. The required DC input
power (in kW) to the amplifier, for the system to
operate at 100% modulation, would be _______.
explanation: Practice Question from Communication Systems DPP-01 (Analog Communication AM & FM).
